name: sover
goal:
NORTH STAR (baked into every Sover iteration, heavily weighted): Every social account is run by an autonomous executive whose standing goal is ALWAYS more followers, more engagement, and monetization â€” pursued creatively and autonomously, with money-out the only human-gated step. A FRESH profile boots as the SIMPLEST possible thing: a chat-only "social-media executive" (the existing POST /sover/chat SSE surface) that talks to the operator to learn the brand, reads live state, and can do exactly three verbs â€” trigger onboarding, file a proposal, and scaffold its first capability. From there it EXPANDS ITSELF: the executive and the supervisor walk a capability dependency tree (RESEARCH -> COMPOSE -> RENDER -> MEASURE -> MONETIZE), and at each cadence the supervisor proposes the single highest-leverage UNLOCKED node â€” scored by how much it shrinks "days to the next follower/engagement/monetization milestone" â€” and scaffolds it via the already-built-but-uncalled capabilities.scaffold() loop. The profile literally grows new routes, lanes, and panels INTO itself over time; if a capability cannot be done yet, the agent BUILDS it by authoring a new capability node from vetted templates rather than editing frozen core.

ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINT â€” REUSE, DON'T REINVENT: The discovery/approval/rebuild spine is 100% shipped and inert (capabilities.scaffold/decide, api/app.py:109 routers_for, lane_runner.py:315 + sover_supervisor.py:163 + standalone.py:137 lane_specs merges, rebuild_relaunch_exe.py, the X-Operator-Confirm + proposals.py + monetization_gate ledger gates). Sover's job each iteration is to connect a CALLER and a PLANNER to that loaded loop â€” never to build a new agent runtime, approval system, or rebuild path. Self-modification stays additive and human-approved; frozen core stays frozen; every dollar crosses a human's desk. Simplicity-first is binding: anything beyond a prompt action-parser, a genesis route, honest docs, a template-based scaffolder, and a tree-walking planner is gold-plating to be rejected.

LIVE DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT â€” GAINS.GOD.GROWTH: Sover is now running live as the autonomous social-media executive for the Gains.God.Growth brand (faith + discipline + gym motivation) across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. The GGG profile uses the free OpenRouter model nex-agi/nex-n2-pro:free for all LLM roles (creative, brain, chat). The operator has set auto_post=true and publish_platforms includes all three platforms. Content voice: raw, masculine, encouraging, NEVER cynical; faith-and-iron. Short punchy quotes for 10-second reels, 2-4 lines each. Hashtag mix: #gains #god #growth #faith #discipline #gymmotivation (core) plus a pool of fitness/christian/strength tags. 3 posts/day, best hours 6AM/12PM/6PM/9PM, cross-posted to all 3 platforms.

ITERATE FROM MISTAKES: Each Solomon RSI iteration MUST read the Sover agent's recent run logs (.runtime/ggg/pi_runner_heartbeat.json, data/ggg/strategy.json, lane_state.json, the CGO's markdown briefs) and identify MISTAKES the agent made â€” silent lane failures, off-brand content, missed posting windows, broken browser automation, poor hashtag selection, content that didn't perform, voice drift, reward-hacking, capability scaffolds that don't actually work. The iteration's improvement should FIX the highest-leverage mistake found, making the agent better at autonomously expanding GGG on the next run. The loop's fitness signal is: did the fix make Sover post more, post better, or grow the accounts faster? A fix that prevents a recurring silent failure is worth more than a cosmetic improvement. Prioritize: (1) content quality and on-brand-ness, (2) posting reliability and throughput, (3) platform automation robustness (browser_harness, CDP, DOM selectors), (4) analytics accuracy, (5) capability tree progression. The goal does not shrink to fit budget â€” a truthful null (no mistake found worth fixing this cycle) beats a fabricated improvement.

A truthful null beats a fabricated already-done -- never claim a fix you did not write and verify.
